content.value: Perform the structural design of a pre-cast pile under a column to carry the (25) superimposed load of 200 kips. The pile is to be driven to hard a strata which is available at a depth of 30 ft. Use $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 3 0 0 0$ psi and $f _ { y } = 6 0 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement details.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
